verdict.rationale: Featurebase advertises workflow automations (SLAs, trial extensions, discounts), webhooks for instant reactions, and the Fibi AI agent that autonomously resolves customer issues, which together suggest background automations. However, there is no detailed documentation on how these workflows are configured, triggered, or scheduled, nor independent verification that they run fully autonomously without manual oversight. Missing for 10: detailed workflow/automation builder docs, trigger/condition specifics, evidence of unattended scheduling, and independent hands-on confirmation.
